title: A chapel the fire got to first
description: Roof gone, walls black to the height of a man. The altar stone is whole, and something under the ash on it has kept its shape — a reliquary, sealed, warm to the touch though the fire is years dead.

choices.text: Read the seal and open it.

onPass.narration: The script is old temple-hand; the seal is a plea, not a lock. Inside, a vial of something that hums against the glass.

onFail.narration: The seal was a warning. Heat goes through the hand that touched it, up the arm, and out through every rib.

onPass.narration: Silver fittings, at least. The thing inside cracks and goes to vapour before anyone can catch it.
You set the ash back over it as you found it.
